newsitem.title: USA: Today's Man says reorganization is okay'd.
newsitem.headline: Today's Man says reorganization is okay'd.

text.p: Today's Man Inc said Thursday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the district of New Jersey has approved its plan to restructure its financial obligations.
If the plan is successful, the company said in a statement, chief executive and founder David Feld will preserve a majority interest in the company.
Today's Man operates menswear superstores in Philadelphia, Washington and New York.
